args.subject: Book Club Meeting Invitation
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I'd like to invite you to our book club meeting! We meet every Tuesday evening at 7 PM at the local library. We are currently reading mystery novels.

Hope to see you there!

args.subject: Bakery Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery
args.body: Hi Alice, I highly recommend checking out The Artisan Bakery downtown. Their sourdough bread is incredible, and they bake it fresh every morning at 6 AM!

args.subject: Cooking Class Invitation: Italian Cuisine
args.body:
Hi Bob,

I'm writing to invite you to a cooking class at the Culinary Arts Center next week. It's a hands-on Italian cuisine class on Wednesday evening. Hope you can make it!

args.subject: Yoga Instructor Recommendation
args.body: Hi Charlie, I wanted to recommend Rachel as a yoga instructor. She's excellent and teaches at the community center on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
